# GitHub Labels for opencode-serve

Four labels: `bug`, `enhancement`, `docs`, `chore`. Apply with `gh label
create`, e.g.:

```bash
gh label create "bug" --color "d73a4a" --description "Something isn't working"
gh label create "enhancement" --color "a2eeef" --description "New functionality"
gh label create "docs" --color "0075ca" --description "Documentation only"
gh label create "chore" --color "fef2c0" --description "Routine maintenance"
```
